walkthrough: ^Take the point: the gate is held
supply_run_offer: ^The exchange clerk at Luyten Crossing doesn't look up from the manifest.
^"Twelve tons for Marrow. Seed stock and pump parts. The commons pay on delivery, and they pay late."
^Ask why nobody else will fly it

c-0: ^"Dock four. If the Harrow boys hail you at the far gate, don't stop."
c-1: ^"Marrow's a long way to go for a short purse. And the Harrow band has been taxing the far gate all season."
^"Suit yourself. It'll be here tomorrow, and so will the price."

supply_run_done: ^The cargo bay opens on a station that is mostly patches. A person in a borrowed pressure suit signs for the crates without counting them.
^"Tally Ashgrove. I organise things here, when they let me. You came in on the far gate?"
^Ask about the lights on the Lantern road

c-0: ^"Nobody, properly. The commons can't afford to. The Harrow band taxes whoever it catches there, and the lord says it's his whenever there's a cut to be had."
c-1: ^"The enclave. Monists. They keep to themselves and take in children nobody else will. Don't ask them for anything they haven't offered."
c-2: ^"Ships that come back. Fuel at a fair price. Someone who'll fly the far gate when the band is out."
c-3: ^"Come back when you're passing. We'll have work, if we're still here."

b:
^Tally is waiting at the dock, thinner than you remember.

^"You've heard about the Luyten road."

^A person in a borrowed pressure suit meets you at the dock.

^"Tally Ashgrove. I organise the commons. You came in on the far gate, so you've heard about the Luyten road."

crossroads_offer: ^"Half the Association run comes through Marrow now. That makes the far gate worth taking, and the Toll took it this morning."
^Offer to help the commons hold the point
^Tell them to take the Crown's protection

c-0: ^"Tolls first. Then the Yard. Then us."
c-1: ^"The agents from Kestrel Hold will protect the lords for an oath to the Crown. They don't say what happens to the commons, or to the enclave."
c-2: ^"They might. They'd want something nobody here can give them. Leave them out of it for now."
c-3: ^"You know what that means. The Toll will want you dead, and when the Crown hears, so will they."

c-1: ^"I thought so. Think on it, but not for long."

c-4: ^"Maybe we will. Maybe they'd even keep their word."

take_the_point_briefing: ^"The Toll has gunships on the far gate and a picket at the Hollow road. Break the blockade and they'll call for help from Harrow Drift. Be waiting at the Hollow road when it comes through."

c-0: ^"We'll have the Yard's guns ready, such as they are."
c-1: ^"Every day they hold it, they take a cut of everything we have."

take_the_point_done: ^The far gate's beacon comes back on in the commons' colours. Someone on the Yard has painted over the band's mark by hand.
^"It's ours," Tally says, as if trying out the words. "Now we find out what that costs."
